text:
zoe: Quick report 1: onboarding sample with js-sdk@2.4.x fails in local worker dev. Error: "Cannot use import statement outside a module". Also observed duplicate token POSTs.
mike: do you have package.json exports and the import line?
zoe: exports: { ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs" }, "./package.json": "./package.json" } and sample does `import { Redwood } from 'redwood-js-sdk'`.
nana: (ping) ana here 1. Probably bundler resolves the import condition but then transforms modules into a cjs wrapper for HMR; .mjs in a cjs wrapper -> runtime syntax error. Duplicate token looks like two module instances loaded (esm + cjs) leading to init side-effects twice.
mike: short repro I ran: sample-edge + vite + wrangler dev. Confirmed. Explicit import `redwood-js-sdk/dist/esm/edge.mjs` fixes both issues locally.
zoe: that works as a workaround but we need a plan. Customers hitting it during quickstart is bad.
nana: plan suggestions: 1) make SDK init idempotent (guard module-level init), 2) include a dedicated edge entry file (dist/esm/edge.mjs) and mention it in samples, 3) evaluate adding conditional typings or explicit `types` mapping so TS picks right declarations, 4) CI smoke test for edge sample with wrangler+vite.
mike: we should avoid nonstandard export conditions like "edge" in package.json; instead publish the edge entry and document the explicit path. Less magic for bundlers.
zoe: I'll open a small PR to update sample README with explicit edge import and a troubleshooting note about bundler transforms + .mjs.
mike: I'll prototype a minimal init guard: module-scoped boolean + awaiting any in-flight init promise before starting another token fetch. Should prevent duplicate POSTs even if two instances load.
nana: also add a tiny debug log showing resolved module filename on startup so we can detect if both cjs and esm copies ended up in the bundle. That'll help for customer repros.
build-bot: Issue created: RDW-5477 "exports conditional -> edge onboarding syntax error + duplicate init" (labels: devex, sdk-exports, edge)
mike: timeline: guard PR today, sample README PR from zoe, CI job ticketed. If guard looks stable we can ship a patch 2.4.1 and avoid reverting exports.
zoe: thanks. Also adding a short doc blurb: "If you see import errors on Cloudflare/Vite dev, try explicit ESM edge import or set bundler to preserve .mjs semantics."
mike: thumbs up. We'll monitor for more reports and follow up if customers need a revert.
